name: keep-alive
description: Prevent computer from going to sleep

scripts.dev:electron: npm run transpile:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run transpile:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
